mentions.name: AI note-to-visual feed app
mentions.description: This app takes the user's iPhone notes and turns each one into heading text paired with an AI-generated image or short video, presenting them in a TikTok-style scrollable feed where users can interact with entries by adding more notes.
mentions.audience: Personal use: the author turning their own iPhone notes into a scrollable feed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I want to make an app that turns each one into a heading text, and AI generated image or short video. And then I can scroll through them like tik tok and interact with them by adding more notes, etc.
